propositions: Jira Server/Data Center cannot be reconciled by rebar against Cloud because it uses REST v2 instead of v3, wiki/plain-text instead of ADF, PAT bearer auth instead of ACLI subprocess, and name-based user identity instead of accountId

PR #120 proposed a second adapter that duplicated field-mapping logic and reached into private symbols from adapters/jira/, creating an undocumented shared layer with no contract boundary and risk of drift
Field maps are already duplicated and have drifted across three locations (jira_fields.py, outbound_fields.py, config.py) with an undefined deleted-status value causing latent bugs

A single Jira-family sub-seam must consolidate shared logic (value maps, label sanitizer, link relations, rich-text codec contract, user-identity contract) while preserving location-pinned modules via dependency inversion and never relocating adf.py/outbound_fields.py/comment_limits.py

DC backend must reject non-https URLs unless allow_insecure=true is set, never disable TLS certificate verification, read JIRA_PAT from environment only, and require operator-configured resolved_statuses to avoid misclassifying resolved issues as present
